title: Follow each improvement
detail: The updates bell now keeps individual changes in a dated history, so you can see what is new without losing earlier updates.

title: Clearer pages in search results
detail: Page titles, descriptions and links now help search engines find the right ISITUSA pages, including our species profiles and ways to support the work.

title: A closer look at uncertain names
detail: Additional references clarify several species names and classifications. Where sources still disagree, the profile explains what remains uncertain.

title: Profiles that are easier to read
detail: Refined photo, naming and county-record sections keep the important details together, with more comfortable layouts on smaller screens.

title: Clearer species cards
detail: List, compact and grid views bring photos, county counts and profile links into a clearer layout. Photo credits remain close at hand.

title: New guidance for every species
detail: Explore updated descriptions, identification tips and practical next steps for all 2,504 species, with expanded name search, checked references and newly verified photos.

title: More ways to explore nearby species
detail: Choose several environments on the map and in the species directory. A larger mobile map, shorter map guidance, clearer profiles and additional credited photos make it easier to explore the records.

title: A smoother way to explore and support
detail: Mobile search and filters open smoothly, the map key explains its colors more clearly, and checkout uses our ISITUSA name. Refined About spacing and a responsive woodland footer bring the pages together.

title: New illustrations and improved checkout
detail: Two original illustrations give our research papers more room to breathe. One-time and recurring contributions now open Stripe's current checkout layouts reliably.

title: More ways to see the map
detail: Monochrome and Spectrum add two new map palettes, with all six choices together on phones. Clearer About links and an original pixel woodland that follows your light or dark theme make it easier to explore the project.

title: A clearer introduction to ISITUSA
detail: Our About page now follows one reading path through who we are, our mission, and the research behind the tool. Footer links keep email updates and preferences together.

title: More room for the map on mobile
detail: Compact search, filters, and recent updates leave more space for the map. County and ZIP lookup, species search, and map controls stay close at hand.

title: New ways to take part
detail: Tell us your skills and availability through the volunteer application, explore the sighting-report page, or choose a contribution option in the more compact Support page.

title: A closer look at our research
detail: Our approach and data-sources papers explain how we work with records and their limitations. Organized credits help you follow the resources behind the project.

title: Get to know ISITUSA
detail: A shorter About page brings our purpose, research sources, and ways to help together. The footer is simpler, with easier access to privacy choices.

title: More ways to explore and contribute
detail: Explore species profiles and their county records, suggest a correction, or choose how you would like to support the work.

title: A clearer way to explore
detail: A continuous map color scale, flexible species views, and county research pages that lead with recorded findings. The research release date is shown separately below.
